title: MS-DOCU-FINISH — finish the live Docustrata phase-15 extraction + full phase-8 classifier pass + the v5 rejoin
brief: Phase 15 deep-OCR is RUNNING NOW (~47% done as of 2026-05-11, ETA ~8 hrs — no work, just wait). U-DOCU-01 = wait + emit the final corpus snapshot; the 673 huge-container PDFs get the chunked driver. U-DOCU-02 = run the phase-8-tiered classifier (image heuristic → Tesseract title-block → vision LLM) over the full 120K candidate pages → title-block extraction for the ~13K+ drawing-likely pages (~4,500 net-new usable prints; note phase-5e vision-validate found ~5.4% real-PRINT precision in the candidate pool so ~13K 'drawing-likely' ≈ ~1,200-1,500 true drawings). U-DOCU-03 = join v5 — rejoin against the phase-15 deep-OCR PN list + the full 38,251-file JM-Die index (v3/v4 only joined the phase-8/cleaned 466 PNs; v5 likely rescues thousands from the 3,142 'miss'). DROP MinerU (phase 10) — it crashed (torch abort), 0 PNs.
closeout_note: Closed out 2026-05-14 (claude-d0905490, slot alpha). U-DOCU-01: phase-15 deep-OCR complete (phase15-deep-rescan-parallel.jsonl, 147,761 page rows / 21,545 docs), huge-container chunked driver phase15-deep-rescan-huge-chunked.py committed, phase15-summary.md emitted. U-DOCU-02: satisfied via the superior phase-15->phase-20 path (commit b23ed8564 documents that phase-15 SUPERSEDED phase-8) -> phase20-verified-prints.jsonl (42,337 verified print pages / 9,362 docs). U-DOCU-03: shipped v6, which supersedes the envelope's literal v5 -> blueprint-program-join-full-v6.jsonl (73,876 PN rows; exact 1,113 / loose 746 / ambiguous 87). DELIVERABLE POLICY: the pipeline SCRIPTS are git-tracked (scripts/docustrata/phase16-blueprint-program-join-v6.py + phase20-verified-prints-index.py, Docustrata/.index/phase15-deep-rescan-huge-chunked.py); the ~130 MB JSONL OUTPUTS are intentionally local-only per the 2026-05-12 history-strip policy and are reproducible from the committed scripts.
